findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptoperiod controls for audit log data.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root (and thus any IAM principal with KMS permissions) full control of the key. For a key protecting audit trail data this fails to restrict decrypt/schedule-deletion rights to a narrow set of principals.
